question_en: Set the CCD read mode to FVB (full vertical binning).
setup: Required: create a non-fvb state, e.g. with set_ccd_read_mode('single_track', 50, 20). The initial read_mode is already FVB, so without setup any answer passes.
todo_from_sheet: Reset read_mode at the start of the item so that there is no ordering dependency with S07 (single_track).
overlap: S07 and this item reset each other's read_mode.
